onset.Description: Onset of the event in seconds relative to the start of the scan

duration.Description: Duration of the event in seconds

Levels.active block: Performing a sequential finger tapping task. Participants sequentially touch the thumb with the index, middle, ring, and little finger with the right hand and eyes closed, starting with the auditory 'Start' cue and ending with the 'Stop' cue.
Levels.baseline: Rest condition with eyes closed and no task performed.
